metadata.title: Out-of-Fold (OOF) Model Error Diagnosis and Provenance Catalog
metadata.evaluation_protocol: Leak-Proof Cluster-Stratified Murcko Scaffold 5-Fold Cross-Validation (Zero In-Sample Leakage)

cases.source_dataset: Octant HLM Microsomal TDI Assay (Curated Set)
cases.rationale: The source CYP3A4 TDI label is 1, while the saved 2D and augmented scores are 0.0422 and 0.0176. Both fall on the negative side of a 0.5 decision threshold. This is a prediction error, not evidence for a particular metabolic pathway. The assay does not identify a reactive metabolite or explain why either model made this prediction. These case scores are retained from the diagnostic catalog; their full per-row prediction provenance is incomplete.
